messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for infra-high-latency - region eu-west-1. Latency spike > 99th percentile for NLP-inference service. Incident ID INC-2026-0421. :warning:
maya: acked, jumping on it. grabbing logs. anyone else?
jordan: I'm on traces. seeing repeated retry storms from batch worker pool. throttling config may be not applied.
maya: digging into autoscaler, looks like scale-up didn't finish - GKE nodepool hit quota. hitting k8s events: 'FailedCreatePod' due to InsufficientResources.
ana: I'm pausing noncritical backfills to free GPU capacity. can you confirm which customer jobs are backfills?
maya: pausing jobs with label 'job-type=backfill' - command: ```kubectl -n inference get pods -l job-type=backfill -o name | xargs kubectl delete``` done.
sre-lead: good. @maya please start handoff in 20m to @oncall-next if we can't stabilize. also capture affected tenants list for SLA assessment.
jordan: stabilization: autoscaler resumed after manual quota bump. latency normalizing. tail of requests still erroring (502) from model proxy. pushing restart of proxy deployment now.
oncall-next: noted, will be ready for handoff. prepping playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/incident-proxy
maya: proxy restart rolled out. errors down to <1% over 10m window. marking incident mitigated at 1925004725. will keep monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 marked MITIGATED by maya at 1925004725. Duration 00:18:04. Pages: 3. Customers potentially impacted: 22 tenants, 5 enterprise accounts flagged. :white_check_mark:
cs-mgr: please compile list of affected enterprise accounts and estimated customer-visible downtime per account. we need to assess SLA credit scope.
maya: attaching quick snapshot: ```Affected accounts: AcmeCorp (10m degraded), DataNorth (22m outage), Marketly (5m degraded), EduPlus (22m outage), FinSecure (18m degraded)``` this is from request logs between 1925004300-1925004725.
jordan: rough calc: total cumulative customer minutes impacted = 10 + 22 + 5 + 22 + 18 + (17 other tenants ~ avg 4m = 68m) = 145 customer-minutes.
mike (finance): I can prepare draft SLA credit amounts but need the invoices and billing identifiers. Provide tenant IDs and plan tiers. Standard credit formula = (downtime minutes / minutes in billing period) * monthly subscription fee (prorated).
maya: tenant IDs: AcmeCorp:t-9123, DataNorth:t-7731, Marketly:t-1102, EduPlus:t-4490, FinSecure:t-5560. Plans: AcmeCorp=Enterprise Pro, DataNorth=Enterprise, Marketly=SaaS-Standard, EduPlus=Enterprise, FinSecure=Enterprise Pro.
mike (finance): thanks. can you add expected start/end timestamps and severity classification? I'll open billing-adjustments ticket and loop in accounting. Ticket template: ```/tickets create billing-adjustment --incident INC-2026-0421 --est-credit ˜$X --accounts t-9123,t-7731,... --owner mike``` I'll fill numbers after verification.
sre-lead: action items before postmortem: 1) Confirm root cause (nodepool quota + missing autoscaler alert) - owner: jordan, due: +2d. 2) Add autoscaler healthcheck & alert - owner: maya, due: +3d. 3) Update runbook and add quota checks to preflight - owner: ana, due: +5d. 4) Finance ticket for SLA credits - owner: mike, due: +2d. 5) Notify affected customers via CSM - owner: cs-mgr, due: +1d.
cs-mgr: will prepare customer outreach drafts. prefer to wait until finance confirms credit amounts before sending enterprise notices. :calendar: 
maya: scheduling postmortem meeting: proposed time 1925080000 (UTC timestamp) => Tue 2026-04-01 15:00 UTC. pinging attendees. Agenda: timeline, root cause, mitigations, action items, SLA/billing.
jordan: adding monitoring query we used: ```sum(rate(proxy_5xx{region="eu-west-1"}[1m])) by (tenant)``` saved as dashboard 'Proxy 5xx by tenant'.
mike (finance): opened ticket #BA-4021, attached tenant list and initial estimate placeholder. tagging @cs-mgr and accounting. I'll post final amounts after verifying invoices (ETA 2 business days).
oncall-next: taking residual monitoring until handoff. leaving note in incident channel: handoff at 1925005000 to oncall-next. :wave:
maya: thanks all. closing thread for now — follow-ups tracked in BA-4021 and postmortem scheduled. :thumbsup:
